name: service
description: Two aids for a project that serves an API, on top of the baseline: a read-only performance-analyzer agent that does a static review of changed server code for blocking calls, per-request cost and unbounded work and reports anything that needs profiling or a load test as NOT CHECKED, and an api-doc skill that writes an OpenAPI description from the routes the code actually defines, using a template inside the skill. No hooks, no settings, no gate, no framework templates.
adoptNotes: Both files install anywhere a .claude/ directory exists and need no gate runner. performance-analyzer is a read-only review spoke (model claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium effort, tools Read, Grep and Glob only, so it never runs a command): nothing in the baseline's hub-and-spoke instructions dispatches it by name, so ask for it after changing server code, or add it to the project's own CLAUDE.md review step. It reviews source statically and cannot profile or load-test, so it reports those as NOT CHECKED instead of guessing. api-doc ships an OpenAPI template (openapi-template.yaml, inside the skill directory) and reads the project's own route or handler code to learn what to document, so it works for any framework; it writes a docs file (docs/api/openapi.yaml by default) and never touches src/ or tests/, and it marks anything it cannot confirm from the code as TODO and unverified.
